scope: packet-only architecture proposals; tools/MCP disabled; runtime NOT_RUN
summary: Changes: (1) INT-A is redefined as a temporary isolated Next.js runtime harness. It is a dedicated test-only Next root outside src/ that uses the installed pinned dependencies, with one harness-only POST Route Handler that executes the unmodified shared httpRequest inside Next before REST to unchanged Go 52b60a4 and PostgreSQL. This endpoint needs explicit PO approval within INT-D01. The Node-only runner becomes INT-A0, an explicit reduced-scope exception, available only on reported infeasibility. (2) The split is grounded in the supplied http-client.ts. App-client mode observes only the decoded body, or ApiError status/code/details and NETWORK_ERROR/TIMEOUT. Wire mode (raw fetch in the same Next route) covers Location, ETag, media type, request-ID echo, T6 malformed JSON and T7 missing Content-Type (byte body). No wire request repeats an app-client POST/PATCH; W1 creates its own record. Evidence is tied to request IDs. The endpoint uses a fixed case allowlist, an env-only loopback base URL and no caller-supplied URL/path/header/body, so it is not a proxy. It returns a bounded envelope; upstream responses are copied, never altered or re-emitted. INVALID_RESPONSE is never classified as success. (3) Removed: the local $0 claim and the F3 lowest-cost ranking. Cloudflare figures are marked inherited and not re-verified; F1/F2 Server Action and partial-prefetch support is NOT_TESTED. P-HOST-1/P-BE-3/P-FE spike requests and the priority question are removed (future separate authorization). There is no restore or cadence rerun absent a new defect. (4) T9 and T10 use fresh, different names. PostgreSQL is a new owned container using its own writable layer or a dedicated new volume (no existing volume, no tmpfs; Codex chooses after approval), with real stop/start of the same container, a container/storage identity check and a name-collision check. (5) The OIDC note now states that the ID Token is a JWT and access-token format depends on the IdP. The cache wording is changed to 'no response cached across users'. The receipt formula is marked candidate, not a PO decision. A 'Decision class' row was added so every INT-D table has 16 fields; if the packet's 16-field list names a different field, that label should be swapped. Remaining limits: everything is NOT_RUN. Feasibility of the cross-root import inside the pinned Next, the loopback binding option and the product-glob exclusion are unconfirmed (Antigravity). The harness runs on the development server only, so there is no build/start claim. The Go request-ID log presence is unknown from the packet. T7 depends on the runtime fetch not adding Content-Type to byte bodies. Auth, authorization and isolation remain deferred.
